projectLink.basis: Staff report explicitly lists both matter IDs and dates. Each original letter verifies its own matter and date; M10305 expressly cites M09997 and the April 8 approval.

facts.label: Approval of proposed project and source of funds
Original total estimate including previously approved funding
Additional project funding and source approved
Total revised project cost stated by Board

revisionChain.revisionReasonAsAttributed: The later Board letter recounts Halifax Water’s explanation that bids exceeded the pre-tender estimate, chiefly for the concrete reservoir, amid pandemic-related material and labour pricing uncertainty. This explanation is attributed, not independently audited.
revisionChain.additionalSourceAsApproved: Surpluses in previously closed projects and projects deferred or cancelled; proposed source approved by Board.

budgetComparison.basis: Explicit project/matter chain plus equal stated totals; not merely an amount-based entity match.

conditionsAndLimits.approvalQualification: Both approvals based on information provided; proposed source of funds approved. No separately numbered conditions stated in these letters.
conditionsAndLimits.designScope: Original letter accepts proposed 2.4 MG prestressed concrete reservoir design; no completed-delivery inspection inferred.
conditionsAndLimits.scope: Two original decision letters only; not all exhibits, prior capital-budget approvals, later amendments, contracts, bank payments or delivery records.
conditionsAndLimits.financial: These approval/estimate/budget stages are not cash payments. Do not add component approvals to inclusive totals or subtract staff expenditure to allege a loss or verified savings.
conditionsAndLimits.currency: Letters use dollars; explicit currency code and detailed tax basis not established in these two letters.
conditionsAndLimits.publication: Institutional paraphrase and numbers only. Full letters, signatures and contact details not republished; public listing is not an open-licence grant.

attribution: Nova Scotia Utility and Review Board decision letters and Halifax Water staff report; no endorsement implied.
